import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000;
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> G;
    static char[][] A = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] B = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] id = new int[15][15];
    static int cnt;
    static int S, T, limitT, n, zx, zy;
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static boolean inside(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && A[x][y] >= '0' && A[x][y] <= '9';
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        int ui = G.get(u).size();
        int vi = G.get(v).size();
        G.get(u).add(new Edge(v, vi, c));
        G.get(v).add(new Edge(u, ui, 0));
    }

    static void buildNetwork(int sx, int sy) {
        if (B[sx][sy] != 0) {
            addEdge(id[sx][sy] + cnt, T, B[sx][sy] - '0');
        }
        if (A[sx][sy] == '0') return;
        addEdge(S, id[sx][sy], A[sx][sy] - '0');
        if (B[sx][sy] != 0) {
            addEdge(id[sx][sy], id[sx][sy] + cnt, 10);
        }

        int[][] d1 = new int[15][15];
        int[][] d2 = new int[15][15];
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(d1[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(d2[i], -1);
        }

        Queue<int[]> qa = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Queue<int[]> qb = new ArrayDeque<>();
        qa.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        qb.add(new int[]{zx, zy});
        d1[sx][sy] = 0;
        d2[zx][zy] = 0;

        while (!qa.isEmpty()) {
            int layer = qa.size();
            while (layer-- > 0) {
                int[] cur = qa.poll();
                int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];

                if (d2[x][y] >= 0) continue;

                for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                    int nx = x + dx[i];
                    int ny = y + dy[i];
                    if (inside(nx, ny) && d1[nx][ny] < 0) {
                        d1[nx][ny] = d1[x][y] + 1;
                        if (d1[nx][ny] > limitT) break;
                        if (d2[nx][ny] >= 0) continue;
                        qa.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        if (B[nx][ny] != '0') {
                            addEdge(id[sx][sy], id[nx][ny] + cnt, 10);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            layer = qb.size();
            while (layer-- > 0) {
                int[] cur = qb.poll();
                int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];

                for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                    int nx = x + dx[i];
                    int ny = y + dy[i];
                    if (inside(nx, ny) && d2[nx][ny] < 0) {
                        d2[nx][ny] = d2[x][y] + 1;
                        qb.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] level, ptr;

    static boolean bfsLevel() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        level[S] = 0;
        q.add(S);

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : G.get(u)) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[T] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int f) {
        if (u == T) return f;

        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < G.get(u).size(); ++i) {
            Edge e = G.get(u).get(i);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    G.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
            ptr[u]++;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfsLevel()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(S, 10000000)) > 0) ans += pushed;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        limitT = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                A[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                B[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) Arrays.fill(id[i], -1);
        cnt = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j;
                } else if (inside(i, j)) {
                    id[i][j] = ++cnt;
                }
            }
        }

        S = 0;
        T = 2 * cnt + 1;
        G = new ArrayList<>(T + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= T; ++i) G.add(new ArrayList<>());

        level = new int[T + 1];
        ptr = new int[T + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (inside(i, j)) buildNetwork(i, j);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
